display.$description: Brand serif reserved for the Oneiros wordmark, splash title, and rare short poetic title.

body.$description: Primary UI, body, and reflection font. Greek-safe, restrained, and used across the app.

semibold.$description: Alegreya Sans medium style used as restrained semibold UI emphasis.

sm.$description: Secondary labels, helper text, compact metadata.

md.$description: Default body text, inputs, common UI copy.

lg.$description: Large labels and compact section headings.

xl.$description: Primary in-app screen titles and prominent list/item titles.

xxl.$description: Large onboarding or exceptional headings. Avoid for routine in-app section titles.

xxxl.$description: Reserved large heading size for sparse onboarding/lock screens only.

splash-title.$description: Live loading splash title size for Oneiros.

splash-subtitle.$description: Live loading splash subtitle size for Dream Journal.

tight.$description: Tight line-height ratio used for compact display text.

normal.$description: Normal line-height ratio used for general readable UI copy.

relaxed.$description: Relaxed line-height ratio used for dream reflections, interpretation copy, reports, and essays.

ui.$description: Restrained sans for labels, navigation, inputs, buttons, and cards.

reflection.$description: Long-form reflection and report text stays in the sans family with relaxed line-height.

splash-title.$description: Live loading splash title letter spacing.

splash-subtitle.$description: Live loading splash subtitle letter spacing.
